candidates.description: This feature vector detects fragments of Hindi script and text tokens.
These tokens represent consonant-vowel combinations and common syllabic blocks in North Indic scripts like Hindi.
This vector represents common inflectional suffixes and vowel-consonant clusters in the Hindi language.
These tokens represent short Hindi verb roots or stems starting with common consonants (like ब, ल, ह, क, स, द).
This vector represents characters, diacritics, and sub-word fragments commonly found in Indic scripts like Hindi and related Devanagari text.
This vector represents Hindi vowel signs and dependent vowel modifiers, particularly the dependent vowel 'e' (ê) and its combining character forms.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Hindi characters, vowels, and word fragments, as well as the English letter 'A'.
This vector represents sequential numerical values within the one-hundred-eighties range.
This vector activates on fragments of Hindi script and text.
This vector activates on non-English script fragments and subword tokens from various writing systems such as Devanagari and Vietnamese.
